label: Blank custom project
summary: Start from an owner-defined idea without forcing it into a known launch category.
requiredFacts: The complete user outcome and lifecycle
Every actor, asset, value flow, authority, dependency and failure path
Which behavior belongs onchain and which behavior belongs in an application or service

Whether any token or Uniswap v4 market boundary applies; when it does, bind the exact boundary, and when it does not, mark it inapplicable and bind the actual external or non-launchable integration boundary
requiredTests: Lifecycle happy path and every declared failure path
Authorization, value conservation and user-exit properties
Capability-specific adversarial tests after architecture review
risks: Unknown trust or value boundaries must remain explicit
A missing adapter can delay integration without making the idea unsafe
